name: Dying Wish
summary: Marshal Ryan is dying and asks you to carry his crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant. His final words turn toward home and Abigail.

sections.title: Ryan’s Last Words
sections.body: As Ryan’s eyes grow dull, he speaks of home and Abigail. The Marshal gives you his crest and asks you to warn Knight Commander Demar Brant. You carry the sign of his rank to Farholde Keep, where the commander awaits.

faq.answer: Marshal Ryan is dying when he asks you to take his crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant.

faq.q: What does Ryan want me to do?
faq.answer: Ryan asks you to carry his crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant and warn him.
Ryan's final words mention Abigail and say he should have come home.

faq.q: Where do I take the crest?
faq.answer: Take Marshal Ryan's crest to Knight Commander Demar Brant in Farholde Keep.
